name: cursor-claude-code-bridge
description: Run Claude Code inside Cursor on your Claude subscription (no API key), via the official claude CLI.

claudeCodeBridge.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `claude` CLI binary. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH.

claudeCodeBridge.cwd.description: Working directory for the claude process. Leave empty to use the first workspace folder.

claudeCodeBridge.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Permission mode passed to `claude --permission-mode`. In non-interactive mode, tools that need approval are denied under `default`; use `acceptEdits` or `auto` to let Claude Code act. `bypassPermissions` skips all checks — use only in trusted workspaces.

claudeCodeBridge.enableToolBridge.description: Expose this IDE's `vscode.lm` extension tools to Claude Code via a local MCP server. Automatically disabled if the IDE does not support the Language Model Tools API.

claudeCodeBridge.includeEditorContext.description: Prepend the active file, selection, and diagnostics to each prompt (per-message toggle also available in the chat panel).

claudeCodeBridge.allowedTools.description: Extra tool patterns to pass to `claude --allowedTools` (e.g. "Bash(git *)", "Edit"). The bridge's own MCP tools are allowed automatically.
